svg.title: Nursing assistant — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as nursing assistant, wearing a care tunic. Visible work cue: A blood-pressure cuff connects through an open hose to a round pressure gauge with a single needle. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Appearance: a bob haircut, an oval face.
